scope: Independent review of parent analysis; generated full-pipeline predictions and source-universe counterexamples only; no actual seal, fatigue observations analyzed, plans or model fits.

checked.frozen_source_integrity: load_frozen runs before reading results; verifies runtime/input hashes. Result CSV hashes and seal match are also checked.
checked.complete_expected_universe: Run tasks exactly match frozen episodes; all17 model aliases and4 fixed policies are declared. Every model/policy has exactly the expected(group,condition,seed,k,queryID) universe; whole-family structural deletion is rejected.
checked.common_query_contrasts: Same-k policy/model comparisons require exact query identity sets. k0 can include additional conditions unavailable at larger k, but only after full expected-universe validation. Truth/event arrays checked on matched rows.
checked.strict_numeric_missingness: Unavailable q/score rows remain in the full universe. All-NaN utility family keeps its source position and suppresses strict bootstrap interval; gate becomes indeterminate rather than dropping the family.
checked.cost_coupling: Support costs reconstructed from each selected original-row prefix, with same-ID cost coupling. Model aliases reuse identical ledgers; costs are not multiplied by repeated query rows.
checked.source_aggregation: Validated query→seed→condition→source normalization and source-only bootstrap helpers. Existing outcomes historically seen; source-bootstrap intervals descriptive, not physical-build/R90C90 confidence.
checked.no_posthoc_selection: Predictor/config choices come from upstream committed inner selection; analysis only reports prespecified comparisons and thresholds. No outer utility selects candidates or model-class members.
checked.class_counts: Five adaptive classes only. Hierarchical/curved require both declared members; scalar/joint RFL require both members and count as one. Any adequately available supported utility reversal blocks robustness. This conservative both-member rule prevents choosing the friendliest member after results.
checked.criteria: Relative availability>=.95, utility lower95>=log10(1.05), paired-risk upper95<=.02,cost-ratio upper95<=.90. Absolute-risk upper95<=.10 separate. Primaryk3/cap1M; other rows retain their explicit k/cap/subset context.

limitations: Finite logutility is conditional on paired finite quantiles and must always be read with reported availability.
Robustness can be supported by >=3 available classes even if another class is indeterminate; the unavailable class is not promoted to success.
Per-class both-member pass/reversal treatment is conservative; it does not establish architecture or mechanistic novelty.
Actual scientific result validation, convergence receipts and fresh replay remain pending until the planned runs complete.
